name: Folding platform truck 720 x 470 mm, folded
description:
The same folding platform truck as PT7247 with the handle folded forward over the deck, the way it is stored: about 730 x 470 x 230 mm. Useful for planning where the trolley lives when it is not in use - under a shelf, behind a door, on top of a stack.

External dimensions: length 730 mm, width 470 mm, height 230 mm.

Generic folding platform truck (flatbed trolley) of the common 150 kg class: 720 x 470 mm deck, 100 mm casters, handle folds flat over the deck. Takes one 600 x 400 euro container with room to spare.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 1,692 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Folding platform truck, 720 x 470 mm deck, handle folded flat - true-scale unbranded GLB, about 230 mm tall for storage.
